candidate.raw_translation: Setiap pemain mendapat tujuh jubin. Jubin berganda tertinggi dalam mana-mana tangan akan dibuka; jika tiada tangan mempunyai jubin berganda, jubin bernilai tertinggi akan dibuka. Sepadankan satu hujung jubin dengan salah satu hujung terbuka baris. Dalam mod tarik, ambil jubin dari stok sehingga anda boleh bermain atau ia kosong. Dalam mod blok, berikan apabila anda tidak boleh bermain. pusingan berakhir apabila tangan kosong atau kedua-dua pemain tidak boleh bergerak; pemain dengan kurang pip yang tinggal memenangi pusingan terhalang.
candidate.source: Each player gets seven tiles. The highest double in either hand opens; if neither hand has a double, the highest-value tile opens. Match one end of a tile to either open end of the line. In draw mode, take tiles from the stock until you can play or it is empty. In block mode, pass when you cannot play. The round ends when a hand is empty or neither player can move; the player with fewer remaining pips wins a blocked round.

audit.back_translation: Each player gets seven tiles. The highest double tiles in any hand will be revealed; if no hand has a double tile, the highest value tile will be revealed. Match one end of the tile with both ends of the open row. In drag mode, pick a tile from the stock until you can play or it is empty. In block mode, send when you can't play. The round ends when the hand is empty or both players cannot move; the player with the fewer pips left wins the blocked round.
